title: Codex edit gate blocks after active claim proof
summary: During the verified session-claim retry for the execution brain memory seam, the worker successfully created an attempt worktree, started the graph task, explicitly bound /overlay/claim-session, and verified /active-claim returned claimed:true for the worker session and task. Despite that proof, the next apply_patch to lib/git-claims.js was rejected by the PreToolUse hook with `orch-gate: no task claimed`. The attempt worktree stayed clean and the task was marked failed. This means the remaining blocker is in the Codex hook/session correlation path used by the edit hook, not ordinary branch_task/start_task ordering; retrying more workers will repeat the failure until that hook path is fixed or the user explicitly opts out.
